description: Browse a live index of Beehiiv newsletters, fetch newsletter profiles, or export recent posts with titles, authors, dates and optional full text. No login, cookies or API key required.

category.description: Topic filter for the directory (mode=discover). Leave empty for every topic.
category.title: Directory category

dateFrom.description: Only keep posts published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no lower bound.
dateFrom.title: Published after

dateTo.description: Only keep posts published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no upper bound.
dateTo.title: Published before

frequency.description: Directory filter for newsletters with a published cadence (mode=discover). Frequency is known for a subset of listings.
frequency.title: Publishing frequency

includeContent.description: Fetch each post page and add its public article text (mode=searchPosts/getPost). Slower and uses more requests; paywalled bodies are never bypassed.
includeContent.title: Include full post text

maxItems.description: Maximum total records to save (newsletters or posts).
maxItems.title: Max records

maxPostsPerNewsletter.description: Cap on posts collected from each newsletter (mode=searchPosts).
maxPostsPerNewsletter.title: Max posts per newsletter

enumTitles: Get newsletter profiles (by URL or subdomain)
Get single post details (by post URL)
mode.title: Mode

postSearchQuery.description: Only keep posts whose title or excerpt contains this keyword (mode=searchPosts). Uses the newsletter archive search when available.
postSearchQuery.title: Post keyword

searchQuery.description: Keyword matched against newsletter name and listing text in the Beehiiv directory (mode=discover).
searchQuery.title: Directory keyword

startUrls.description: Newsletter homepages (e.g. https://aibreakfast.beehiiv.com or https://www.therundown.ai) for getNewsletter/searchPosts, or direct post URLs (…/p/slug) for getPost.
startUrls.title: Newsletter or post URLs

subdomains.description: Bare Beehiiv subdomains such as aibreakfast or tldr. They are resolved to https://<subdomain>.beehiiv.com. Custom domains belong in startUrls.
subdomains.title: Beehiiv subdomains

title: Beehiiv Directory, Profile & Post Extractor
